pages.text: Sends a PATCH request: changes a part of something on the server.$(br2)The data is sent as UTF-8. Set its type in the $(1)Content-Type$() header of the connection, like $(1)application/json$().

$(li)$(1)connection$() STRUCT c0de_net/http/HTTP_CONNECTION: the server$(li)$(1)endpoint$() STRING: the path behind the base endpoint (optional, default empty)$(li)$(1)data$() STRING: the data sent with the request (optional, default empty)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the raw data of the answer
$(li)result $(1)status$() INTEGER: the HTTP status$(li)result $(1)headers$() HASH STRING: the headers of the answer
$(1)state$() is a BOOLEAN variable with the tag $(1)json: "on"$(), so TO_JSON of c0de/strings writes $(1){"on":false}$() (see the example Switching a lamp).

$(1)CALL c0de/strings/TO_JSON$(br)  PARAMETER value state ;$(br)  RESULT result data$(br)CALL c0de_net/http/HTTP_PATCH$(br)  PARAMETER connection api ;$(br)  PARAMETER endpoint "/lamps/kitchen" ;$(br)  PARAMETER data data ;$(br)  RESULT status status$()
